Paisa Diary privacy policy

Last updated 13 November 2026

In short

  • Paisa Diary has no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking.
  • Everything you enter stays on your phone. We never receive it.
  • The app only uses the internet for Google Drive backup, if you turn it on, and for purchases through Google Play.

Who we are

Paisa Diary is made by SKonsole, an individual developer. In this policy, "we" means SKonsole and "the app" means Paisa Diary on Android.

What the app keeps on your phone

Your diaries, entries, categories and settings are saved in the app's own storage on your phone. They are not sent to us or to anyone else, and we have no way to see them.

What we don't collect

We don't collect any personal information. The app has no sign-up, no analytics, no crash reporting and no advertising. It does not read your SMS, contacts, location or files, and it does not connect to your bank.

Feedback you send us

Report a bug and Suggest a feature in Settings open your own email app with a message to us already started. It includes the app version, your Android version and your phone model, to help us fix problems, and never your diaries or entries. Nothing is sent until you press send in your email app, and you can change or remove anything first. If you email us, we receive only what you choose to send, along with your email address, and use it only to reply to you and improve the app.

Features that use the internet, only when you use them

  • Google Drive backup (optional). If you connect Google Drive, you sign in with your Google account through Google. The app asks only for access to a hidden folder in your Drive that belongs to Paisa Diary, plus your email address, name and profile picture so it can show which account is connected. The picture is loaded from Google when that screen is shown. Backups go straight from your phone to your own Drive; we never receive them. Google's privacy policy applies to your Google account and Drive.
  • Purchases (Pro and add-ons such as extra diaries). Payments are handled by Google Play. When the app opens, it asks Google Play which of its purchases your Google account owns and what they cost in your country, so it can unlock them and show the right prices. We never see your card or payment details.
  • Backup files you save or share. When you save a backup to a folder on your phone or share it with another app, the file goes only where you choose.

Permissions the app uses

  • Internet: only for Google Drive backup and Google Play purchases.
  • Notifications: for backup reminders, which are scheduled on your phone. No notification comes from a server.
  • Fingerprint and face unlock: for the optional app lock. Android checks your fingerprint, face or PIN and only tells the app whether it passed. Your biometric data never reaches the app or us.
  • Run at startup: so backup reminders still arrive after your phone restarts.

Keeping and deleting your data

  • Your data stays on your phone until you delete it.
  • To erase everything in the app, use Settings, then Reset application. Uninstalling the app also removes its data from your phone.
  • To delete backups stored in Google Drive, open Google Drive on the web, go to Settings, then Manage apps, find Paisa Diary and choose Delete hidden app data. You can also disconnect Drive in the app at any time.
  • Backup files you saved or shared yourself stay where you put them until you delete them.

Keeping your data safe

Your data is protected by your phone's own security. You can also turn on app lock in Settings, which asks for your fingerprint, face or phone PIN when you open the app. Backup files are not encrypted, so keep them somewhere you trust.

Children

Paisa Diary is meant for adults. It is not directed at children, and we don't knowingly collect information from anyone, including children.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the new version will appear in the app and on this page with a new date at the top.
